text:
Sophie L: Heads up — AcmeCorp just flagged a month-end mismatch. Dashboard shows 1,253,412 tokens for Feb billing window, invoice sent shows 1,031,102 and the invoice line is priced under Growth tier. They say they were on Pro. @billing-team can you confirm what tier applied?
Luis M: ack — can you paste account id + invoice id?
Sophie L: acct_acme_321, invoice INV-2026-02-ACME-47. Dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/acct_acme_321/usage?window=2026-02
Maria C: pulling invoice now. billing-bot: exported CSV attached (billing-bot: /exports/INV-2026-02-ACME-47.csv)
billing-bot: Export ready: /s3/billing/exports/2026-02/INV-2026-02-ACME-47.csv
Jin K: quick check — did the account change plan mid-month? can we see subscription history?
Alex R: subscription history shows plan change on 2026-02-28 23:58 UTC from Pro -> Growth (edge case).
Sophie L: customer insists they didn't change; they use SSO-managed billing — possible webhook missed?
Rashmi: hypothesis: cutoff window uses UTC and subscription effective time applies immediately, so if change happened at 23:58 it could flip month pricing. But that wouldn't change tokens totals, only unit price/tier.
Luis M: tokens mismatch likely from our aggregation window. Are we including in-progress streams or partial token flushes?
Jin K: running repro query against metering:
```
SELECT sum(tokens) FROM token_events
WHERE account_id='acct_acme_321'
AND ts >= '2026-02-01' AND ts < '2026-03-01';
```
Result: 1,253,412

Alex R: invoice pipeline used snapshot at cutoff 2026-03-01 00:05 UTC which reads 1,031,102 — looks like a late backfill applied to dashboard after invoice snapshot.
Maria C: any backfills scheduled around 2026-03-01?
billing-bot: Backfill job 2026-03-01T00:02 triggered for log ingestion, status COMPLETED, rows_added=222310
Sophie L: that 222k gap matches difference between dashboard and invoice (1,253,412 - 1,031,102 = 222,310).
Rashmi: so root cause: backfill inserted late tokens after invoice snapshot. Need to decide whether to reissue invoice or credit.
Luis M: standards: for >100k token delta and customer complaint, we should issue a credit for the delta tokens on next invoice and tag as 'late ingestion backfill'.
Alex R: engineering note — set backfill run to complete before invoice snapshot or block snapshot if backfill in-flight; also add alert when rows_added > 10k within 2m of snapshot.
Sophie L: action items: @billing-team create 222,310-token credit for acct_acme_321 ref INV-2026-02-ACME-47; @eng-ml add guard to snapshot pipeline; @support send update to customer that we're issuing credit and monitoring.
Maria C: filing support response now, cc finance.
Sophie L: thanks everyone, I'll follow up once credit issued. :thumbsup:
